subject: Invitation to our Annual Company Gala
body: Dear Employees, We are excited to invite you to our Annual Company Gala, which will be held on Saturday, November 20th at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of celebration, entertainment, and networking. Dress code is formal attire. Please RSVP by November 5th to secure your spot. We look forward to seeing you there! Best regards, [Company Name]
